description: I am responsible for myself and myself only #bigsisteradvice #selflove #selfmastery
transcript: I am responsible for me. I am accountable for myself. There is nothing that can come from the external world and pass through my internal world without giving me the entire PDF file before. I do not allow my life to free roam. I am in full control of the way in which I respond and what I allow to fill my internal world.
